name: Box
label: Box Platform API 2.0 — files and folders
description: Box Platform API 2.0. Docs: https://developer.box.com/reference/. upload POSTs multipart attributes+file to https://upload.box.com/api/2.0/files/content (not api.box.com). Direct upload max 50 MB. Bearer access_token minted outside StudioQuack. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets on this port. File bytes are type file.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official Box Platform API 2.0 verb. EXACT: copy_file | delete_file | download | get_file | search | share_file | upload | create_folder | get_folder | delete_folder | share_folder | update_folder | listen. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: upload.

schema.label: name
schema.description: File or folder name. copy_file, create_folder, update_folder body `name`. For upload put it inside attributes.name. Example: Contract.pdf.

schema.label: file_id
schema.description: Box file id for get/copy/delete/download/share. Example: 12345.

schema.label: folder_id
schema.description: Box folder id for get/delete/share/update. Example: 0.

schema.label: parent
schema.description: Official parent folder object {id}. copy_file, create_folder, update_folder. Prefer parent_id. Example: {"id":"0"}.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Comma-separated fields query for get_file, share_file, get_folder, share_folder. Example: id,name,shared_link.

schema.label: recursive
schema.description: delete_folder query `recursive`. true deletes contents. Example: true.

schema.label: file
schema.description: upload multipart part `file` (bytes). Official host upload.box.com. Max 50 MB for this endpoint; larger files need chunked upload (not implemented).

schema.label: attributes
schema.description: upload multipart part `attributes` (JSON). Official: {name, parent:{id}}. Must be sent before file. Example: {"name":"a.pdf","parent":{"id":"0"}}.

schema.label: jwt_public_key_id
schema.description: Box JWT public key id (kid) for jwt_app auth.

schema.label: jwt_passphrase
schema.description: Passphrase for the Box JWT private key. Never log.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Box access token minted outside StudioQuack (OAuth, JWT, or CCG). StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: JWT Public Key ID
configurationParameters.description: Box JWT public key id (kid) for jwt_app auth.

configurationParameters.label: JWT Passphrase
configurationParameters.description: Passphrase for the Box JWT private key. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
